outcome_summary: Added the `ledger_ping` MCP tool as a lightweight (~50-token) health-check alternative to `ledger_help` (~2,000 tokens). The tool returns reachability status, running server version, stale-instance detection, and uptime. The PM persona preflight partial was updated to use `ledger_ping` instead of `ledger_help`, so agents now catch stale servers at the very start of a run with explicit `stale` field checking rather than inferring health from a successful documentation response.
project_summary: Adds a lightweight ledger_ping MCP tool as a zero-argument health-check alternative to the existing ledger_help connectivity check, reducing preflight token cost from roughly 2,000 tokens to roughly 50 tokens per run. The tool returns reachability status, running server version, a stale-instance boolean, and uptime seconds, enabling agents to detect rebuilt-but-not-restarted server instances before beginning a workflow. The PM persona preflight partial is updated to use ledger_ping instead of ledger_help, catching stale servers at the very start of a run.
